- If you defect in Round $ n $, they will defect in Round $ n+1 $.

Because the opponent mirrors your previous move, your **entire sequence of moves defines the entire game**. If you cooperate consistently, they will always cooperate. If you defect once, they will defect in the following round, and so on.
